blocks: SGR train clocks 2 million passengers: The Standard Gauge Railway (SGR) passenger train service, the Madaraka Express, has ferried its two-millionth passenger since launch in May last year.

SGR train clocks 2 million passengers: At a ceremony in Nairobi to mark the milestone yesterday, Kenya Railways Corporation unveiled Ms Rose Mbogo, a nurse by profession, as the lucky passenger to have helped it achieve the fete.
